name: Reyna
source:
Reyna is a beautiful half-elf woman who has dedicated her life to serve [url=https://vndb.org/c131855]Frank[/url]. She is fiercely protective of him and will do anything he asks her to do. Her servitude to him began in the year 30 AD shortly after his previous incarnation saved her and her people from slavery and certain death. While her admiration and appreciation was her original motivation to serve him, she grew to love him so dearly that nothing could shake her dedication.

She is one of the founding members of the Oathbound. After his death in 33 AD, she got together with others who had sworn oaths to him, like [url=https://vndb.org/c131900]Draxus[/url], and began to form the organization so Frank would have his people ready to aid him in his next life. Her people are also appreciative and would be glad to help Frank, but the connection Reyna has developed to Frank is unique, making her his greatest servant and most dedicated follower.

The tattoo on her cheek is to commemorate the moment she was saved by Frank's previous incarnation. The waves of water represent the tidal wave he parted when he saved her life.

[In game description]
